import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Constants
ARRAY_SIZE = 10000


def task_func():
    # Generate random integers from 1 to 100 inclusive
    values = np.random.randint(1, 101, size=ARRAY_SIZE)

    # Compute statistics
    mean_val = float(np.mean(values))
    std_val = float(np.std(values))

    # Create histogram
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 5))
    ax.hist(values, bins=20, edgecolor="black", alpha=0.75)

    # Plot mean as a red dashed line
    ax.axvline(mean_val, color="red", linestyle="--", linewidth=2, label="Mean")

    # Plot standard deviation as purple dashed lines (mean ± std)
    ax.axvline(mean_val - std_val, color="purple", linestyle="--", linewidth=2, label="Mean - Std")
    ax.axvline(mean_val + std_val, color="purple", linestyle="--", linewidth=2, label="Mean + Std")

    # Labels and title
    ax.set_title("Histogram of Random Values")
    ax.set_xlabel("Val")
    ax.set_ylabel("Freq")
    ax.legend()

    return values, mean_val, std_val, ax
